draft.emotion: matter-of-fact, simply describing a physical feature
notes: Used in the singular ('el pelo') for all the hair on a person's head, or as a countable noun ('un pelo') for a single strand.
'El pelo' is the everyday word in Spain; 'el cabello' is more formal and refers only to head hair.

senses.definition: The mass of thin strands that grow on a person's head, or a single strand of it.

examples.text: Ella tiene el pelo largo y castaño.

senses.definition: The fine strands covering the body of a person or an animal.

examples.text: El perro tiene el pelo muy suave.
examples.translation: The dog has very soft fur.
